title: 2.11 Taller than Sofia
unit_title: Places, things and how we describe them
unit_outcome: Say where people go and how they get there, talk about the things people have, point things out and compare them, put things in order, and ask about favorites.
goal: Compare two people or two things with -er than (Luis is taller than Sofia. / The bus is bigger than the car. / I am older than my brother.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 2.11 Big and Small: A1 says It is a big dog. / It is a small dog. about one thing at a time; A1+ 2.11 compares two in one photo with the -er form and than (The brown dog is bigger than the white dog.). big doubles its g (bigger). It brings back A1+ 1.1's tall, short, old and young and 1.5's older and younger, now with than (My brother is older than me.). Two people or two things share each photo: Sofia beside Luis (1.1), Luis with his older and his younger brother (1.5), a bus beside a car, a big brown dog beside a small white dog, and a grandfather beside a boy on a bench.
prerequisite: A1 2.11 big, small; A1+ 1.1 tall, short, old, young; A1+ 1.5 older, younger, my brother; A1 2.2 bus, car; A1 1.10 dog; A1 brown, white; A1+ 2.10 the brown one; A1 2.12 or.
speaking_outcome: Say than with a soft th and a weak vowel (thən), linked to the comparative (TALLer than). Do not require native-like speed.
